outputs.explanation: Panel A consists solely of micrograph images (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge) with no bar chart or averaged quantification plot; the check does not apply.
The two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity Green/Red and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only mean bars with error bars and no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a Western blot image with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
The SDH and COX signal-intensity bar charts show group means with error bars and sample sizes noted in the bars, but no individual data points are overlaid.

The FACS panels are histogram/distribution plots (cell number vs. TMRM intensity) showing raw distributions rather than averaged summary statistics, so overlaying individual points is not applicable; the schematic portion of the panel is not a data plot.
